patterns.what_worked: Fixing the mode rule in ONE place (Core.ApplyTooltipFieldModeRule) instead of the two copies that had drifted; recording the dropdown's initializer and its menu items in the harness mock, which is what made the hard-coded-English menu visible at all; a guarded evaluator handed to Cache.ReevaluateAll so the raise is captured once instead of twice; every pin reverted on a copy so no revert ever touched the working tree.
patterns.what_was_hard: The named audit file bench/audits/2026-10-20-final-hunter2.md does not exist, so the nine findings came from the task text rather than from the report; the hit-rect 'floor' wording admits two readings, and only one of them keeps the expansion following the label text, which is what the pin requires; the locale translations had to be written twice because the first pass used wrong Unicode code points for koKR.
patterns.skill_gap: Writing the korean and russian strings as typed characters instead of \u escapes -- the escape pass produced '최재'/"폼균" for "최고"/"평균" and had to be redone.

escalation.recommendation: Operator in-game pass on Classic Era for the two paths only a client shows: closing the leaderboard with the gear panel open, and the mode dropdown reading in the player's language.
